attributes_note: length_m, surface_type, road_class, and bus_stops are derived from OpenStreetMap geometry/tags via the Overpass API (pulled 2026-07-24), not a ground survey. A null value in one of those fields means OSM held no data for it on that date, not that it is awaiting a street walk. A null value in any other attribute means it has not been surveyed on foot yet.

trivia.text: Named after Ana Ventura, a young resistance fighter from a Sephardic Jewish family, killed in 1944 at the age of 18. Her surname derives from a Spanish word meaning fortune or fate.
